crossRefs.note: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all…
The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in Yahweh’s eyes, he will bring me again…
but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you;’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”
He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
Blessed is Yahweh your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because Yahweh loved Israel…
“He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

parallels.note: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

translations.web: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.
translations.bsb: If the LORD delights in us, He will bring us into this land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and He will give it to us.
translations.kjv: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
translations.asv: If Jehovah delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it unto us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
